origin.usage: normalize_state(x, warn = getOption("fansi.warn", TRUE), term.cap = getOption("fansi.term.cap", dflt_term_cap()), carry = getOption("fansi.carry", FALSE))

arguments.name: warn
arguments.text: Warn about malformed or unrecognized sequences.

arguments.name: carry
arguments.text: TRUE or a string whose style is active before x. FALSE starts from no style.

origin.details: Compound SGR sequences are split into one token each. A reset is replaced by the closes for styles active at that point. Identical abutting URLs are merged.
origin.value: A character vector, or a data frame for unhandled_ctl.

translation.details: Compound SGR sequences are split into one token each. A reset is replaced by the closes for styles active at that point. Identical abutting URLs are merged. A string is one element. None is a missing string. term_cap is the R term.cap argument.
translation.value: A list of strings, or a dict of columns for unhandled_ctl.
translation.example:
from fansi.normalize_state import normalize_state
print(normalize_state("\033[4mhello\033[42;33m world\033[m", warn=False, term_cap=["bright", "256"])[0])
